arxiv-2210-03635.title: Bounding the sum of the largest signless Laplacian eigenvalues of a graph
arxiv-2210-03635.creator: Aida Abiad, Leonardo de Lima, Sina Kalantarzadeh, Mona Mohammadi, Carla Oliveira
arxiv-2210-03635.description: Abstract We show several sharp upper and lower bounds for the sum of the largest eigenvalues of the signless Laplacian matrix. These bounds improve and extend previously known bounds. AMS classification: 05C50, 05C35 1 Introduction Consider G=(V,E) to be a simple graph with n vertices such that |V|=n .

arxiv-2303-04129.title: Foundation Models for Decision Making: Problems, Methods, and Opportunities
arxiv-2303-04129.creator: Sherry Yang, Ofir Nachum, Yilun Du, Jason Wei, Pieter Abbeel, Dale Schuurmans
arxiv-2303-04129.description: Abstract . Foundation models pretrained on diverse data at scale have demonstrated extraordinary capabilities in a wide range of vision and language tasks. When such models are deployed in real world environments, they inevitably interface with other entities and agents.

arxiv-2305-12678.title: Gradient-Boosted Decision Tree for Listwise Context Model in Multimodal Review Helpfulness Prediction
arxiv-2305-12678.creator: Thong Nguyen, Xiaobao Wu, Xinshuai Dong, Anh Tuan Luu, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Zhen Hai, Lidong Bing
arxiv-2305-12678.description: Abstract Multimodal Review Helpfulness Prediction (MRHP) aims to rank product reviews based on predicted helpfulness scores and has been widely applied in e-commerce via presenting customers with useful reviews. Previous studies commonly employ fully-connected neural networks (FCNNs) as the final score predictor and pairwise loss as the training objective.

arxiv-2310-07227.title: Fundamentals of pushable homomorphisms of oriented graphs
arxiv-2310-07227.creator: Tapas Das, Pavan P D, Sagnik Sen, S Taruni ( a ) (a) Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad, India. ( b ) (b) Centro de Modelamiento Matemático (CNRS IRL2807),Universidad de Chile, Santiago, Chile. ( c ) (c) University of Turku, FI-20014 Turku, Finland,
arxiv-2310-07227.description: Abstract To push a vertex v v of an oriented graph G → \overrightarrow{G} is to reverse the direction of the arcs incident to v v . A homomorphism of an oriented graph G → \overrightarrow{G} to another oriented graph H → \overrightarrow{H} is an arc preserving vertex mapping.

arxiv-2412-19009.title: FACEMUG: A Multimodal Generative and Fusion Framework for Local Facial Editing
arxiv-2412-19009.creator: Wanglong Lu, Jikai Wang, Xiaogang Jin, Xianta Jiang, Hanli Zhao *
arxiv-2412-19009.description: Abstract Existing facial editing methods have achieved remarkable results, yet they often fall short in supporting multimodal conditional local facial editing. One of the significant evidences is that their output image quality degrades dramatically after several iterations of incremental editing, as they do not support local editing.

arxiv-2507-09616.title: MLoRQ: Bridging Low-Rank and Quantization for Transformer Compression
arxiv-2507-09616.creator: Ofir Gordon, Ariel Lapid, Elad Cohen, Yarden Yagil, Arnon Netzer, Hai Victor Habi
arxiv-2507-09616.description: Abstract Deploying transformer-based neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices presents a significant challenge. This challenge is often addressed through various techniques, such as low-rank approximation and mixed-precision quantization. In this work, we introduce Mixed Low-Rank and Quantization (MLoRQ), a novel method that integrates both techniques.

arxiv-2508-04483.title: Simulation and Benchmarking of Real Quantum Hardware
arxiv-2508-04483.creator: T. Piskor, M. Schöndorf, M. Bauer, D. Smith, T. Ayral, S. Pogorzalek, A. Auer, M. Papič
arxiv-2508-04483.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by T. Piskor, M. Schöndorf, M. Bauer, D. Smith, T. Ayral, S. Pogorzalek, A. Auer, M. Papič. The effects of noise are one of the most important factors to consider when it comes to quantum computing in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum computing (NISQ) era that we are currently in.

arxiv-2606-23470.title: From Lab to Landscape: Assessing the Impact of Pesticides on Pollinator Populations Based on Laboratory Data by Combining ALMaSS and BufferGUTS
arxiv-2606-23470.creator: Florian Schunck

pmc-10507831.title: Association between MTTP genotype (-493G/T) polymorphism and hepatic steatosis in hepatitis C: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10507831.creator: Xiaoxia Wang, Yu Cao, Jia Guo, Dezhao Li, Haitao Zhang, Qingkun Song, Jun Lu
pmc-10507831.description: BackgroundHepatitis C has been associated with the development of hepatic steatosis, which increases the risk of liver cancer. The microsomal triglyceride transporter protein (MTTP), is a lipid transport protein that mediates lipid metabolism and CD1d antigen presentation. The study aimed to explore the association between MTTP genotype (-493G/T) polymorphism and hepatic steatosis in hepatitis C.

pmc-10786232.title: Emotional processing deficits in individuals with problematic pornography use: Unpleasant bias and pleasant blunting
pmc-10786232.creator: Jianfeng Wang, Hong Li
pmc-10786232.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and aimsA growing body of evidence indicates a connection between emotional processes and the emergence and progression of addiction. However, scant research has examined the involvement of emotional processing within the framework of problematic pornography use (PPU).

pmc-11507364.title: Double-Layer Distributed and Integrated Fault Detection Strategy for Non-Gaussian Dynamic Industrial Systems
pmc-11507364.creator: Shengli Dong, Xinghan Xu, Yuhang Chen, Yifang Zhang, Shengzheng Wang, Ali Mohammad-Djafari
pmc-11507364.description: Currently, with the increasing scale of industrial systems, multisensor monitoring data exhibit large-scale dynamic Gaussian and non-Gaussian concurrent complex characteristics. However, the traditional principal component analysis method is based on Gaussian distribution and uncorrelated assumptions, which are greatly limited in practice.

pmc-11639827.title: Alginate vs. Hyaluronic Acid as Carriers for Nucleus Pulposus Cells: A Study on Regenerative Outcomes in Disc Degeneration
pmc-11639827.creator: Shota Ogasawara, Jordy Schol, Daisuke Sakai, Takayuki Warita, Takano Susumu, Yoshihiko Nakamura, Kosuke Sako, Shota Tamagawa, Erika Matsushita, Hazuki Soma, Masato Sato, Masahiko Watanabe
pmc-11639827.description: Intervertebral disc degeneration is a leading cause of chronic low back pain, affecting millions globally. Regenerative medicine, particularly cell-based therapies, presents a promising therapeutic strategy. This study evaluates the comparative efficacy of two biomaterials—hyaluronic acid (HA) and alginate—as carriers for nucleus pulposus (NP) cell transplantation in a beagle model of induced disc degeneration.

pmc-12617091.title: On the performance of pure and group 2B transition metal-doped metal oxide nanocages as single-atom catalysts for the hydrogen storage process: a DFT study
pmc-12617091.creator: Mohammed N. I. Shehata, Lamiaa A. Mohamed, Hu Yang, Tamer Shoeib, Jabir H. Al-Fahemi, Mahmoud A. A. Ibrahim
pmc-12617091.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). For an efficient confrontation of the exhaustion of nonrenewable energy sources issue, the storage of hydrogen as an eco-friendly and renewable alternative energy source has received considerable attention. Herein, the performance of pure and group 2B transition metal-doped metal oxide nanocages (M12O12 and TM-M11O12; where M = Zn, Mg, and Be; TM = Zn, Cd, and Hg) as single-atom catalysts for the hydrogen dissociation reaction (HDR) was investigated using DFT calculations.

pmc-12653239.title: Selective Removal of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETs) Combined with Ex Vivo Lung Perfusion (EVLP): Current Evidence and Future Perspectives
pmc-12653239.creator: Anton Sabashnikov, Sanjay Agrawal, Bartlomiej Zych, Ihor Krasivskyi, Syed Hussain Abbas, Dengu Fungai, Thomas Williams, Louit Thakuria, Andrew Aswani, Mohamed Osman, Maria Monteagudo-Vela, Vasiliki Gerovasili, Anna Reed
pmc-12653239.description: Severe discrepancy between availability of donor organs suitable for clinical transplantation and the proportion of patients on the waiting list has resulted in several clinical problems. First, waiting times for a suitable organ match have become increasingly long, leading to higher mortality while awaiting transplantation.

pmc-13117525.title: Risk Stratification in Primary Gastric Malignancies in Children, Adolescents, and Young Adults: A SEER-Based Analysis
pmc-13117525.creator: Stavros P. Papadakos, Ioannis Katsaros, Stamatina Vogli, Alexandra Argyrou, Ioannis Karniadakis, Ioannis A. Ziogas, Paraskevas Gkolfakis, Stamatios Theocharis, Dimitrios Schizas
pmc-13117525.description: Backgrounds: Gastric malignancies are exceptionally rare among children and young adults, and their clinicopathological characteristics and outcomes remain poorly defined. This study aimed to evaluate the demographic, clinical, and survival features of gastric cancer in patients aged ≤24 years using population-based data.

pmc-13374591.title: Assessing Risk of Early ICU Admission or Death at Emergency Department Triage: Clinical Judgment Versus Early Warning Scores
pmc-13374591.creator: Nicola Bonadia, Piergiacomo Maria Cacciamani Fanelli, Davide Antonio Della Polla, Valeria Maccauro, Giuseppe De Matteis, Andrea Piccioni, Antonio Gasbarrini, Claudio Sandroni, Francesco Franceschi, Marcello Covino
pmc-13374591.description: BackgroundEarly Warning Scores (EWS) are widely used to standardize the identification of clinical deterioration, yet their comparative performance against clinical judgment in Emergency Department (ED) triage remains uncertain. We aimed to evaluate whether commonly used EWS match or outperform clinical judgment in predicting early adverse outcomes.

pmc-13398485.creator: Katherine Power, Qiong Zhang

pmc-13424793.title: Real-World Drug Retention and Safety of Ustekinumab in Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease in Qatar: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13424793.creator: Abdulwahab Hamid, Ahmed Badi, Ahmad Ayash, Yahaya Bensuleiman, Souraia Mezhoud, Mohammed Abderahim Hassan, Alia Battah, Munir Abu Ageila, Abdurahman Kday, Muneera Almohannadi
pmc-13424793.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), is an increasingly recognized condition in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, yet real-world data on advanced therapies from this population remain scarce. Ustekinumab, a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting the shared p40 subunit of interleukin-12 and interleukin-23, has demonstrated efficacy and safety in pivotal randomized controlled trials for both CD and UC. However, its real-world performance in MENA populations has not been well characterized.

pmc-13453562.title: Comparison of Titanium and Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Polyetheretherketone Spinal Implants in Postoperative Spine Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy: A Comprehensive Review of Current Evidence and Future Perspectives
pmc-13453562.creator: Yuhi Suda, Yujiro Nakajima, Kei Ito, Shota Watanabe, Kentaro Taguchi, Satoshi Kito
pmc-13453562.description: Postoperative stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) for spinal metastases presents technical challenges, particularly in the presence of internal fixation devices. Titanium implants—the standard implant material—cause substantial imaging artifacts in computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance (MR) scans, which can lead to target and organ-at-risk contouring problems and compromise the accuracy of dose calculations.
